{{Top|leg}}
The '''[[Six Claws]]''' were six isthmuses that constituted a region of the continent of [[Alanciar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The [[Alanciari]], [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] natives of the area, said that their continent resembled the [[Limb/Legends|leg]] of a local creature known as a [[muntok]]; the Six Claws corresponded to the beast's clawed foot. Two of the spits that made up the Six Claws were [[Point Defiance]] and [[Point Vigilance]]. The region was the continent's westernmost, bordering [[the Shank]] to the east.
